title: When waiting keeps turning bitter as a steady practice
issueStatement: Delay has started feeding resentment instead of ripening trust. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru ties patience to listening, honor, and steadiness rather than passive resentment. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Wait by listening instead of simmering.
actionPrompt: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Repeat what you can actually keep.
